name: WF-414 — Seller Offer Strategy Automation Controller

parameters.jsCode: const b=$json.body??$json; const leadId=String(b.leadId??'').trim(); const propertyId=String(b.propertyId??'').trim(); const dealId=String(b.dealId??'').trim(); return [{json:{...b,leadId,propertyId,dealId,receivedAt:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const input=$('Normalize Seller Offer Strategy Request').first().json; const ctx=$json.context??$json; const d=ctx.deal??{}; const p=ctx.property??{}; const seller=ctx.seller??{}; const risk=ctx.riskValidation??{}; const underwriting=ctx.underwriting??{}; const num=v=>Number.isFinite(Number(v))?Number(v):null; const mao=num(underwriting.recommendedMAO??d.protectedMAO??d.mao); const currentOffer=num(d.currentOffer??d.offerAmount); const arv=num(underwriting.arv??d.arv??p.arv); const repairs=num(underwriting.repairs??d.repairs??p.repairs); const motivation=num(seller.motivationScore??ctx.motivationScore); const urgency=String(seller.urgency??ctx.urgency??'unknown').toLowerCase(); const responseHistory=Array.isArray(ctx.responseHistory)?ctx.responseHistory:[]; const counterCount=responseHistory.filter(x=>String(x.intent??'').toLowerCase()==='counteroffer').length; const riskLevel=String(risk.riskLevel??'unknown').toLowerCase(); const gap=currentOffer!==null&&mao!==null?mao-currentOffer:null; let strategy='human_review'; let posture='balanced'; let recommendedOffer=null; let ceiling=mao; let rationale=[]; if(mao!==null){if(currentOffer===null){recommendedOffer=motivation!==null&&motivation>=70?mao*.92:mao*.88; posture=motivation!==null&&motivation>=70?'firm_value':'anchored'; strategy='initial_offer'; rationale.push('No current offer; create controlled opening offer below protected MAO.');}else if(currentOffer<=mao){recommendedOffer=currentOffer; strategy='hold_or_contract'; posture='firm_value'; rationale.push('Current offer is within protected MAO.');}else{if(motivation!==null&&motivation>=70){recommendedOffer=mao*.98;posture='firm';strategy='reprice_to_mao';rationale.push('High motivation supports a firm value-based ceiling.');}else{recommendedOffer=mao*.90;posture='anchored';strategy='reprice_and_negotiate';rationale.push('Current ask exceeds protected MAO; maintain negotiation room.');}} if(urgency==='high')rationale.push('High seller urgency may support faster decision cycles.'); if(counterCount>=2){posture='firm';rationale.push('Multiple counteroffers detected; avoid uncontrolled escalation.');} if(riskLevel==='high'){strategy='human_review';rationale.push('High deal risk overrides automated escalation.');} if(repairs!==null&&arv!==null&&repairs/arv>=.25)rationale.push('High repair burden requires preserving downside protection.');} const lowerBound=recommendedOffer!==null?Math.max(0,recommendedOffer-(mao!==null?mao*.08:0)):null; const decision=strategy==='human_review'?'human_review':recommendedOffer!==null?'offer_ready':'insufficient_data'; const confidence=Math.round(Math.max(0,Math.min(100,(mao!==null?35:0)+(motivation!==null?20:0)+(currentOffer!==null?15:0)+(riskLevel!=='unknown'?15:0)+(responseHistory.length>0?15:0)))); const idempotencyKey='wf414:'+input.leadId+':'+input.propertyId+':'+input.dealId; return [{json:{...input,offerStrategy:{decision,strategy,posture,recommendedOffer,negotiationLowerBound:lowerBound,protectedMAO:mao,ceiling,offerGap:gap,confidenceScore:confidence,rationale,controls:{maxAutomatedOffer:mao,requiresHumanReview:riskLevel==='high',maxCounterofferCycles:4}},idempotencyKey}}];

meta.notes: Offer strategy is deterministic decision scaffolding pending verified InsulaCRM fields, production communication contract, seller-response NLP, and final approval controls. Protected MAO is never intended to be exposed in seller-facing communications.
